what the reserve check actually uses
below the 17.0 MW ceiling — can deliver
A full battery that cannot deliver the required POWER bridges for zero seconds.
The check is energy ÷ power at the predicted shortfall, and it returns 0 above the
unit's ceiling — so this panel can read CANNOT BRIDGE at 95% charge.
